objective: Move the frontend from react-router-dom 6.30.6 to 7.18.4 or later on the 7 line (React 18 stays), clearing GHSA-337j-9hxr-rhxg and GHSA-wrjc-x8rr-h8h6, with no change in behaviour, so FRONTEND-011's modal navigation is written once against the router it will live on.
acceptance_criteria: frontend/package.json depends on react-router-dom ^7.18.4, and frontend/package-lock.json resolves react-router-dom and react-router to the same 7.x version, at least 7.18.4 and below 8; no 6.x copy of either remains anywhere in the lockfile.
A test under frontend/src/test/ reads the installed react-router-dom and react-router package.json versions and fails unless both are major 7 at 7.18.4 or later.
npm audit --omit=dev in frontend/ lists no advisory for react-router or react-router-dom.
react, react-dom, @types/react and @types/react-dom keep their current major (18); no other dependency in package.json changes version.
Imports keep the react-router-dom package name (in v7 it re-exports react-router); no file imports from react-router directly.

No v6 future flag (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath, v7_fetcherPersist, v7_normalizeFormMethod, v7_partialHydration, v7_skipActionErrorRevalidation) remains in src/, and a test run prints no React Router future-flag warning.
Every existing frontend test passes, and npm run typecheck, npm run lint and npm run build pass, in the frontend-test container as well as directly.

Behaviour is unchanged in the built app (vite preview, light and dark, 360 and 1280 wide): the feed loads; a card opens its thread as a modal over the feed and closing it returns to the feed at the same scroll position; a reply's timestamp opens the nested thread; /posts/<id> loaded directly shows the thread over the feed and closing it lands on /; a search with a query string survives reload; a game page and a player page open from their links; an unknown path shows the not-found view.
